criteria.text: Calculates the service credit as $4,000 (10% of the $40,000 monthly fee for 98.1% availability) and identifies that the supplier's offer of $2,000 is too low.
Identifies that the planned reorganisation may be a change of control deemed an assignment under Clause 19, requiring the counterparty's consent.

Identifies that data protection breaches are not carved out of the $500,000 liability cap in Clause 11, leaving the customer under-protected for data breach losses, and recommends a separate higher cap or carve-out.
Shows the service credit arithmetic (10% x $40,000 = $4,000) and flags the discrepancy with $2,000.
Where a defined term or clause is ambiguous, explains how each alternative reading would work.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
